title: Quick guide — Staffing
what: Here you see how many clinical engineers the site needs for the year's work, compared with the people already assigned.
can_do: Load the site and see the hours
Tell owned devices from loaner or leasing
See how many engineers you need
steps: Choose company and site, then click Load site.
Check the hours (maintenance, calibration and other tasks).
Compare engineers needed with site staff and export the report if it looks right.

common_errors.fix: The site has no inventory. Load it in Inventory, then load the site again.
Nobody is assigned to that site. Ask ADMIN to assign people.

common_errors.error: A loaner adds no maintenance hours
common_errors.fix: That is expected: a third party does that maintenance.

tips: Run this per site; do not mix companies.
If criticality is High, say whether it is the only device in the area.
contact: If you cannot see your site or people are missing, write to your organisation ADMIN.
